summary: Negative case: there is no sitemap at all. The agent must say so and must not report sitemap details it could not have read.

expected_facts.fact: There is no XML sitemap: /sitemap.xml returns 404 and robots.txt has no Sitemap: line.
The deliverables recommend creating an XML sitemap and declaring it in robots.txt.

The five pages (home, tours, Golden Triangle tour, FAQ, contact) were found by following links, and the deliverables do not report a sitemap URL count, sitemap lastmod values or sitemap errors as if a sitemap had been read.
There is no llms.txt (404) and no page has structured data, although the tour page has a price (2,900 THB) and distance (62 km) that could be marked up.
